brief:
Israel has ordered the closure of its British consulate in occupied East Jerusalem, The Guardian reported, in retaliation for sweeping UK sanctions on goods from illegal Israeli settlements. The decision marks an escalation in tensions between London and Tel Aviv over Britain's intensified criticism of settlement expansion in Palestinian territories and its new punitive trade measures.

The British government's stance has prompted broader consequences for officials and lawmakers. Several British MPs have been banned from entering Israel as part of the dispute, underscoring the depth of friction between the two countries over settlement policy and international law regarding occupied territories.
